ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using EventVwr
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of a UAC bypass using Windows Event Viewer

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Event\\ Viewer\\\\RecentViews$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\EventV\\~1\\\\RecentViews$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")))
